actions.check.description: Scan every UUID field, in all locales and in drafts and published versions.
actions.duplicates.description: Give every entry that shares a UUID with an older entry a new one.
actions.export.description: Download every UUID with its entry as a JSON backup.
actions.import.description: Restore UUIDs from an export into empty fields.
actions.missing.description: Fill entries that were created before the UUID field existed.
actions.repair.description: Replace duplicate and malformed UUIDs and fill empty fields in one run.
actions.title: Actions
check.incomplete: Check finished, but some fields could not be checked.
check.lastRun: Counts are from the check you just ran.
code.DUPLICATE_TARGET: An entry appears more than once in the file.
code.DUPLICATE_VALUE: A UUID appears more than once in the file.
code.IMPORT_CONFLICT: A UUID from the file is already used by another entry.
code.IMPORT_FAILED: The import failed and was rolled back. No changes were kept.
code.IMPORT_VALUE_MISMATCH: A value does not match the field's UUID version and prefix.
code.INVALID_IMPORT: The file is not a UUID mappings export.
code.INVALID_REQUEST: The request was rejected. Check the file or the selected options.
code.INVALID_UUID_FIELD_CONFIG: A UUID field has an invalid version or prefix. Check it in the Content-Type Builder.
code.REPAIR_FAILED: The repair failed and was rolled back. No changes were kept.
code.REPAIR_IN_PROGRESS: Another repair or import is running. Try again when it has finished.
code.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
code.SCAN_FAILED: A UUID field could not be checked. No repairs ran.
code.TARGET_HAS_VALUE: An entry already has a different UUID. Existing values are never replaced.
code.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: An entry from the file no longer exists.
code.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
code.UNKNOWN_FIELD: The file contains a content type or field without a UUID field.
field.options.allowEdit.description: Editors and API clients can set and change the UUID. When off, the server generates it and it cannot be changed.
field.options.disableAutoGenerate.descri: Editors enter the UUID themselves. Without manual editing it can be entered once and is then locked.
field.options.prefix.description: Up to 16 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens added before every UUID, for example usr_
field.options.prefix.error: Use 1 to 16 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
field.options.private.description: The field is not returned by the API
field.options.unique.description: Strapi also checks uniqueness when an entry is published. This is not a database constraint; the plugin rejects duplicates on every save.
field.options.version.description: v4 is random. v7 is time-sortable and recommended for new fields. Changing the version later keeps existing values.
form.confirm.body: Links and integrations that use the current value stop working after the entry is saved.
form.confirm.title: Replace this UUID?
form.description: Generates a UUID v4 or v7 for each entry
form.field.configError: The UUID field configuration is invalid. Check its version and prefix.
form.field.copyFailed: The UUID could not be copied. Select the value and copy it manually.
form.field.error: The value does not match this field's UUID version and prefix.
form.label: UUID
form.placeholder: Generated when the entry is saved
hero.body: Every entry gets a UUID on save. Duplicates are rejected, and values that should not change stay locked.
hero.title: Stable identifiers for your content
import.confirmBody: Empty UUID fields get the values from the file. Existing values are not changed.
import.description: Restore UUIDs from an export. Only empty fields are filled; a value that another entry uses is skipped.
import.error.shape: This is not a UUID export: the "mappings" object is missing.
import.field.hint: Or paste the content of a file created with "Export UUIDs".
import.field.label: Export content
import.file.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB. Split the export by content type.
import.title: Import UUIDs
load.error.body: No repairs ran. Check the connection and try again.
load.error.title: The UUID status could not be loaded
models.empty: No content type has a UUID field yet. Add the UUID custom field in the Content-Type Builder.
models.title: Content types with UUID fields
models.unavailable: The list is not available until the status loads.
repair.all.description: Choose what to repair, preview the changes, then apply them. The oldest entry keeps a shared UUID; draft and published versions stay in sync.
repair.all.title: Repair all
repair.applied: {count, plural, =0 {No changes were needed.} one {# change saved.} other {# changes saved.}}
repair.confirm.body: Replaced UUIDs are gone for good: links, integrations and exports that use them stop working. Create a database backup or a UUID export first. This cannot be undone.
repair.duplicates.description: When several entries share a UUID, the oldest keeps it and the others get a new one.
repair.duplicates.title: Replace duplicates
repair.missing.confirmBody: Empty UUID fields get a new value. Existing values are not changed.
repair.missing.description: Fill empty UUID fields. Fields with auto-generation turned off are left empty.
repair.missing.title: Generate missing UUIDs
repair.needed.body: Some entries have duplicate, malformed or missing UUIDs. Use "Repair all" to preview the changes.
repair.needed.title: Repair needed
repair.option.legacy: Values in an older version or prefix (usually kept)
repair.preview.title: Preview

report.duplicates.preview: {count, plural, one {# duplicate UUID would be replaced} other {# duplicate UUIDs would be replaced}}
report.empty.applied: {count, plural, one {# empty field filled} other {# empty fields filled}}
report.empty.preview: {count, plural, one {# empty field would be filled} other {# empty fields would be filled}}
report.imported.applied: {count, plural, one {# UUID imported} other {# UUIDs imported}}
report.imported.preview: {count, plural, one {# UUID would be imported} other {# UUIDs would be imported}}
report.invalid.applied: {count, plural, one {# malformed value replaced} other {# malformed values replaced}}
report.invalid.preview: {count, plural, one {# malformed value would be replaced} other {# malformed values would be replaced}}
report.legacy.applied: {count, plural, one {# value in an older format replaced} other {# values in an older format replaced}}
report.legacy.preview: {count, plural, one {# value in an older format would be replaced} other {# values in an older format would be replaced}}
report.skipped: {count, plural, one {# entry skipped} other {# entries skipped}}
report.unchanged: {count, plural, one {# entry already has this UUID} other {# entries already have their UUID}}
scan.incomplete.body: Repairs are paused until every field can be checked. Review the field options in the Content-Type Builder, then refresh.
scan.incomplete.title: Some UUID fields could not be checked
settings.subtitle: Check, repair and back up the UUID fields of all content types
